topicless.policy: Broad investors, multidisciplinary universities and broad community umbrellas can reasonably have empty topics. Investor specialities require explicit investment mandates, not own technical products or individual portfolio-company sectors. Operating organisations require evidence of their own technical activity. Classify specialist institutes independently; no redundant ancestor tags, arbitrary quota or forced topic assignment.
topicless.mutationWarning: This records no-change decisions, not instructions to clear any current topics. Preserve the identity hold and explicit exclusion.

socialCoverage.meaning: Recorded public organisation accounts only. The links schema has no verification flag; this is not fresh primary-source verification of every account. Missing means no qualifying public account recorded, not verified absence of accounts. No private link URLs are included.
socialCoverage.excludedScope: The all-registry 126 includes user-excluded CLIMADA; excluding it gives 125 missing among 893. Its presence in arithmetic does not authorize research or mutation.
